label: implicit keyspace mapping
type: XDCR's default behaviour of replicating between IDENTICALLY named keyspaces on source and target - available whenever the same scope and collection exist on both sides, with no mapping to configure.
evidence: An _implicit_ mapping is one supported by XDCR whenever the same _keyspace_ exists within both the source and the target buckets.
XDCR's default behavior is always to replicate data between corresponding keyspaces.
note: Promoted as a pair with xdcr:explicit-mapping - the two mapping modes are the axis on which every scope-and-collection replication decision turns, and both are named as such on the same page and used on others.
